title: Jacob's Blessing to His Sons
description: On his deathbed, Jacob gathers his twelve sons and tells them what will happen in the last days. He speaks prophetic words over each one: Reuben loses his birthright; Simeon and Levi are to be scattered because of their anger; Judah is promised the scepter and ruler's staff until Shiloh comes; and Joseph is richly blessed as a fruitful branch. Finally, he blesses each of Israel's twelve tribes.
